ShapeShifter is a robust physical adversarial attack on faster R-CNN object detector that can generate imperceptible physical perturbations that fool the object detector.
we have proposed ShapeShifter, a novel attack that can generate robust adversarial perturbions that are able to mislead an object detection model in the physical world.

our proposed ShapeShifter is the first attack on Faster R-Cnn that generates adversarially pertubed physical images that can fool the object detector, and it does so by leveraging a novel Expectation over Transformation method.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we are the first work to successfully generate physical adversarial examples for object detectors.
we have developed the first robust physical adversarial attack on Faster R-Cnn object detector.
we have proposed the first physical attack on object detector, which is robust enough to survive in real world.

, despite the recent advances in adversarial defenses and the growing awareness in the community, the robustness of DNNs remains an open problem.
physical adversarial perturbation can be generated for object detectors with high accuracy and efficiency, which can be used to fool object detectors in a wide range of applications.
